note: Re-judged 2026-11-20 by an independent agent after df3221e7b8 changed TestMobikeAuthRetransmitKeepsProtectedTuple. RFC 4555 Section 3.9: "when NAT Traversal is not enabled, all messages that can update the addresses associated with the IKE_SA and/or IPsec SAs (the first IKE_AUTH request and all INFORMATIONAL requests that contain any of the following notifications: UPDATE_SA_ADDRESSES, ADDITIONAL_IP4_ADDRESS, ADDITIONAL_IP6_ADDRESS, NO_ADDITIONAL_ADDRESSES) MUST also include a NO_NATS_ALLOWED notification." The change is mechanical: the PeerSession takes its NAT-T socket through ps.sockets.Store(&sessionSockets{natt: iniTr}) instead of a natt field; the assertions are unchanged, so the retransmitted first IKE_AUTH must be byte-identical and carry NO_NATS_ALLOWED with the actual tuple. TestMobikeConfiguredNATPolicy (both tags) and TestMobikeAdvertisementAfterSourceChange are unchanged: under prohibit the IKE_AUTH and the UPDATE_SA_ADDRESSES INFORMATIONAL carry the notification, under allow and the default none do. Ze sends no ADDITIONAL_IP4 or ADDITIONAL_IP6 address. Verdict stands.
